# US-003: Track task status

## User Story

As a Leap Up member, I want to update a task's status, so that progress is visible to the team and client.

## Context

Statuses In Progress, Completed, Pending Review, To Do (L107–L186). Realtime excluded (quote §7; C2 OPEN).

Phase 2 (quote P2) — build after Phase 1 acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

<!-- DRAFT — generated by /ac from the draft SRS · AC must be confirmed by PO/QA before it is final -->

### AC-001 — Status updated

- **Type:** business-rule
- **Covers:** FR-dashboard-tasks-007 / BR-dashboard-tasks-001, 003
- **Screen:** task-list

```gherkin
Rule: status is one of To Do, In Progress, Pending Review, Completed
  Scenario: update
    Given task "Creative Key Visual" is "To Do"
    When Leap Up sets it to "In Progress"
    Then the table shows "In Progress" after the page is loaded again (no realtime push)
```
